question.question: Can append_notify report success for an entry that was replaced by a different decided value at its assigned index before the actor drains notifiers?
question.importance: A false successful write acknowledgment can make callers believe a write committed when its value is absent from the decided log.
contexts: leader change between local acceptance and notifier drain
event_paths: AppendNotify -> local append_tracked assignment -> new quorum leader decides replacement -> AcceptSync replaces origin log -> tick drain_notifiers

supporting_behavior_ids.b_prepare: New authority chooses eligible history excluding the isolated old leader value.
supporting_behavior_ids.b_accept: Replacement is decided through the actual new write quorum.
supporting_behavior_ids.b_recover: Restored old leader synchronizes under the newer promise.

counterevidence: Superseded branch explicitly compares ballots and existing test expects it when original entry is lost.
A value may survive a ballot change, so ballot mismatch alone is not a violation oracle.
unknowns: Whether replacement decision can reach the origin before its next notifier drain and yield a successful result.
question.trigger_rationale: drain_notifiers chooses idx<=decided before ballot invalidation. The existing superseded test refills the position only after waiting for Superseded, excluding the overlap. A bounded public-API history can decide the replacement before the first configured actor tick, resolving this concrete ordering discriminator.

obligation.description: A successful append_notify completion at a returned log index must identify the submitted entry as the decided content at that index; deciding a replacement entry at the same position under a later ballot must not supply successful completion of the original invocation.

scope.description: Locally assigned append_notify across a same-configuration leader change, with original entry excluded from the new quorum history and a different entry decided at the assigned position.
assumptions: Unique distinguishable values and one outstanding notify operation.
Real executor timer; operations and transport can complete before the next actor tick.

grounding.derivation: append_notify promises to await its entry decision; Superseded documentation says the actor stops rather than confirms a potentially lost entry. Its heuristic caveat permits false negative uncertainty, not a successful acknowledgment of different decided content. The existing superseded test explicitly demonstrates a replacement at the same index.
grounding.applicability: One actor owning a locally assigned notify call; two other core replicas; non-Byzantine three-node configuration, no snapshots, default MemoryStorage, public API transport and a real Tokio timer.
alternatives: A changed ballot alone does not prove value loss: a new leader may adopt the entry. This check instead establishes an actual different decided value at the returned position.

bindings.description: Chooses successful position-based completion before ballot supersession.

associations.rationale: Consumes assignment context to complete the caller operation.

feedback.answered: The controller now confirms the snapshot-content violation with no open issues; the related map replaces its answered boundary unknown with the sourced conditional reconstruction behavior. New runtime reading identifies a different consumer: notifier success uses decided position before ballot supersession, while the existing lost-entry test waits for Superseded before deciding a replacement.
remaining: Execute and review the independently fixed runtime overlap check.
Runtime subscriber cursor and buffered StopSign continuation remain separate leads.
feedback.rationale: The next discriminator is actual successful completion of a replaced value, not merely a changed ballot.
